$comment: Accepted high and critical advisories in production dependencies. See docs/educateos/security/dependency-scanning.md before adding an entry; every entry needs a reason and an issue or expiry, and is reviewed in the pull request that adds it.

advisories.reason: Reached only through expo > @expo/cli > @expo/code-signing-certificates, the build and dev-server CLI that runs on developer machines and in builds, not in the app binary.
